hypothesis: Authenticated R8 REDUNDANT delivery is compared with both single-path controls under the same scheduled load and fault, without claims of inferred physical disjointness.

identifiers.seed_ids: exact integers 0 through 219 inclusive; no other seed identifier is valid
identifiers.trial_id: SHA256 ASCII 'r8-q2-v4-trial-id' || seed u32be || condition u8 || mechanism exact UTF-8; lowercase hexadecimal
identifiers.locator_id: SHA256 ASCII 'r8-q2-v4-locator-id' || seed u32be || locator token exact UTF-8; first 16 digest bytes rendered as 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters
identifiers.mac: SHA256 ASCII 'r8-q2-v4-mac' || seed u32be || interface token exact UTF-8; bytes 0..5, then byte 0 = (byte 0 OR 0x02) AND 0xfe (locally administered unicast); six colon-separated lowercase hexadecimal octets; actual values are never stored in evidence

execution_order.algorithm: For each seed and condition independently, compute SHA256(ASCII domain 'r8-q2-v3-mechanism-order' || seed u32be || condition u8 || mechanism exact UTF-8) for every mechanism; sort ascending by digest bytes, then mechanism UTF-8 lexical order; execute that order. Canonical plan order is seed ascending, condition code ascending, then execution rank ascending; every row includes execution_ordinal = seed * 9 + condition_code * 3 + execution_rank, which is exact and unique on 0..1979.

plan_row.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON with lexicographically sorted keys, compact separators, followed by LF per row; SHA-256 over all 1,980 rows in canonical plan order

sampling.blocks: seed // 20; block 0 warmup and blocks 1 through 10 measured

topology.interface_ordinals: 0 source/A-egress, 1 hop-A/ingress, 2 hop-A/egress, 3 destination/A-ingress, 4 source/B-egress, 5 hop-B/ingress, 6 hop-B/egress, 7 destination/B-ingress; only ordinals are stored in evidence
topology.forwarding: exactly two disjoint IP-free two-hop veth paths; no bridge, default route, shared nonloopback interface, or link removal
topology.qdisc_rule: flap-A mutates 0 and 3; flap-B mutates 4 and 7; both directions 100% loss; no-flap performs no qdisc mutation

premeasurement_gate.profile3_admission: before slot-one activation, all five protected controls traverse the actual native topology: LOC_UPDATE over path A; BIND_PROBE, BIND_CHALLENGE, BIND_RESPONSE, and CANDIDATE_RESULT over candidate path B in their protocol directions; each receiver derives NativeBinding only from its actual receiving endpoint descriptor and validated L2 peer
premeasurement_gate.ready: the child signals admission-ready only after handshake authentication, exact native candidate proof, both slot-one activations, and setup receive drain; readiness is bounded and failure is retained
premeasurement_gate.baseline: after admission-ready, the parent drains every setup frame, verifies clean qdisc/state, captures wire counters plus parent/daemon CPU baselines, then selects T and opens one shared start gate
premeasurement_gate.cpu: child-self CPU is captured immediately after the shared gate and at bounded completion; retained CPU is gated child-self plus gated parent/daemon deltas; setup/admission CPU is excluded
premeasurement_gate.prohibition: no in-memory or caller-asserted admission bypass is allowed in measured execution

schedule_and_fault.clock: CLOCK_MONOTONIC_RAW; stored times are signed integer ns relative to T
schedule_and_fault.packets: i=0..399; scheduled_time(i)=T-1s+i*10ms; interval [T-1s,T+3s); packet rows have exactly one row for every trial_id/packet_index pair; each active path has at most one authenticated copy
schedule_and_fault.send: send_relative_ns is null only for not_sent; otherwise send_relative_ns >= scheduled_time(i)
schedule_and_fault.on_schedule_receive: [scheduled_time(i),scheduled_time(i)+20ms]; authenticated delivery has exactly one earliest authenticated receive timestamp and on_schedule is derived from that interval
schedule_and_fault.pre_T_readiness: packet indexes 90..99 must all be on-schedule authenticated deliveries with receive <= T; evidence retains their longest consecutive run, and readiness_relative_ns is their maximum receive time only when all ten qualify
schedule_and_fault.qdisc_actual_observation: for each start/end command, actual state is the first successful post-command state read
schedule_and_fault.flap: each start and end absolute deviation from T and T+1s respectively MUST be <=100ms, inter-end skew MUST be <=100ms; otherwise retain finite failure_reason flap-timing
schedule_and_fault.recovery: only eligible flap trials with a valid later flap-end origin enter at 0; the tenth consecutive on-schedule authenticated delivery scheduled strictly after origin is the event, stored as receive_time minus origin; otherwise censor at min(2s, observed follow-up); missing or invalid origin enters and censors at 0
schedule_and_fault.aggregates: sent is the count of nonnull sends; delivered is authenticated logical deliveries; lost=400-delivered; duplicates=sum(max(path_A_count+path_B_count-1,0)); reorder_displacement_count increments for an arrival whose packet index is below the maximum prior arrived index; max_consecutive_loss_burst is derived in packet-index order; valid-flap degraded_interval_ns=later end minus earliest start, no-flap is zero, invalid fault is null. Wire/CPU/queue values are retained host observations. Every trial aggregate exactly equals evidence.metrics.
schedule_and_fault.no_flap: flap start/end and recovery fields are null; no-flap is excluded from recovery estimand; it remains in failure and loss estimands

evidence_identity.canonical_json: UTF-8 JSON with lexicographically sorted keys and compact separators (comma `,`, colon `:`), no whitespace; SHA-256 digest rendered as 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
evidence_identity.environment_id: SHA-256 of the canonical environment object after removing only environment_id.
evidence_identity.topology_id: SHA-256 of the canonical topology object after removing only topology_id.
evidence_identity.evidence_id: SHA-256 of the canonical evidence row after removing only evidence_id.
evidence_identity.invariants: All 1,980 evidence rows have one identical canonical environment object and environment_id; that environment identity is fixed across Q2 series. For each seed, exactly one identical canonical topology object and topology_id is shared by its nine condition/mechanism trials; topology.seed equals that seed. The environment_id, topology_id, and evidence_id fields are excluded only from their respective preimage objects; no domain prefix, salt, or other ID-domain bytes are included.

analysis.population: all 200 measured seeds (blocks 1..10); retain every failure and timeout; warmup excluded
analysis.failure_rate: per mechanism and condition numerator is trial status != completed; denominator 200
analysis.loss_rate: per mechanism and condition numerator is every one of the 80,000 logical schedules without authenticated delivery by T+3s, including not_sent, failed, and timeout; denominator 80,000
analysis.contrasts: for each measured seed and condition, calculate exact paired REDUNDANT minus single-A and REDUNDANT minus single-B differences for failure and loss; retain all 200 pairs

recovery.estimand: RMST through 2s by Kaplan-Meier, flap conditions only
recovery.valid_later_end_origin: later valid flap end; enter at 0; tenth consecutive on-schedule authenticated delivery after origin is event
recovery.missing_or_invalid_origin: enter and censor at 0, nonestimable for RMST while retained for failure and loss

bootstrap.draw: for r=0..9999 and pos=0..9, SHA256 ASCII 'r8-q2-v4-block-draw' || r u32be || pos u8; selected block=1+(first 8 digest bytes as u64be mod 10); no PRNG
bootstrap.ci: percentile 95% endpoints sorted zero-based floor(0.025*(B-1)) and ceil(0.975*(B-1)); required denominator or paired member absent is nonestimable

analysis.quantiles: type-7 p50 and p95 only when estimable; p99 unsupported
